svg.title: Coding DNA, template DNA and the RNA transcript
svg.desc: Original short fragment: coding DNA5prime ATG GCA3prime complements template DNA3prime TAC CGT5prime. The template is used for transcription giving RNA5prime AUG GCA3prime. RNA matches the coding strand except U replaces T. Roles and sequence directions are explicit; this is not a complete gene.

g.text: Name the strand before deriving RNA
Original invented sequence fragment · no complete gene or patient variant
Shown in the same 5′ → 3′ direction as the RNA below
Complementary DNA strands run in opposite directions.
Template pairing: T → A, A → U, C → G, G → C
Built 5′ → 3′; U is used instead of T
Complement the template. Match the coding strand except T / U.
Transcription makes RNA; translation at a ribosome follows as a separate stage.
A short pair of codons is not enough to infer a complete protein or its activity.
